edges: M - 114 was a former state trunkline highway around the city of Grand Rapids.
M - 114 started at US 16 in Walker Township.
M - 114 terminated at US 131 in Plainfield Township.
A Bypass US 16 designation was assigned to the portion of M - 114 that traveled around the southwest side of Grand Rapids.
A leg of M - 114 continued west along 3 Mile Road.
M - 114 terminated at Coit Avenue near the Grand River.
